messages:
maya: quick copy review for the Export CSV empty state in Insights. current message is 'No data to export' which is kinda generic. product wants to suggest why and next steps.

joel: most common reasons: filters exclude all results, timeframe too narrow, or metric aggregation hasn't finished. we should surface the most likely cause and an action link.

tess: yes. keep it short and scannable. suggestion: title and one-line help + a subtle action link. avoid ordering the blame on users.

maya: proposal strings:
Title: 'No results to export'
Body: 'Try widening the time range or removing filters. If metrics are still processing, wait a few minutes and try again.'
Action link: 'View export options' (opens a popover with format/limit notes)

design-bot: suggested single-line tooltip/alt text for SR: 'No results available for the selected filters and timeframe. Try widening the time range or removing filters. If metrics are processing, wait a few minutes.'

joel: add a microcopy hint under the action link when users hit limits: 'CSV export limited to 50k rows; use the API for larger exports.' keep this muted.

tess: accessibility: ensure the action link is keyboard focusable and the empty state image has alt text. also add aria-live polite when the export button is disabled so SR users get notified why.

maya: final engineer-ready strings:
Heading: 'No results to export'
Body: 'Try widening the time range or removing filters. If metrics are processing, wait a few minutes and try again.'
Action link: 'View export options'
Limit hint: 'CSV export limited to 50,000 rows. Use the API for larger exports.'
SR announcement: 'No results available for the selected filters and timeframe. Try widening the time range or removing filters. If metrics are processing, wait a few minutes.'

joel: thanks — i'll include these in the component PR and add the popover content. tagging eng to make the limit hint conditional when result_count > 50000.

tess: LGTM. small emoji: :file_cabinet:
